limits: Unseeded independent games, not cloned states
Cleanup substitutes two report actions; effect includes their opportunity cost
Incident guard is an empirical lookup used by a research bot, not a transferable Skill or true risk oracle
Post-assignment events and choices can differ as consequences of earlier state changes
Missing/interrupted episodes are not coded as failures or successes
Intervals are descriptive exploratory rate intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted superiority tests
No post-assignment survivor subgroup is used as the primary denominator
Results apply to the frozen empirical research bot and eligible L2 population, not all new careers or reasoning agents
